title: Lior and the Choir Anew
author: A. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
